sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: For more than six decades, Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater has captivated audiences around the world with performances that blend breathtaking athleticism, expressive storytelling, and the rich traditions of modern dance—celebrating the depth, resilience, and beauty of the human spirit.
body: For more than six decades, Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater has captivated audiences around the world with performances that blend breathtaking athleticism, expressive storytelling, and the rich traditions of modern dance. Founded in 1958, the company has become a cultural touchstone, celebrating the depth, resilience, and beauty of the human spirit while honoring the rich heritage that continues to shape its artistic vision. In these uplifting performances at the Boch Center Wang Theatre, extraordinary dancers radiate passion, precision, and joy from the stage. Join us for performances that continue a beloved dance tradition, one that invites audiences to feel deeply, rejoice together, and share in the exhilaration of live performance.
